1#main: To bury in the ground, and if they bury two dead together. In it are 6 seifim. One who places his dead in a coffin and does not bury him in the ground transgresses because of 'you shall surely bury him'; and if they placed him in a coffin and buried him in the ground, he does not transgress; nevertheless it is proper to bury him in the ground itself, even outside the Land.
2#main: They place the dead on his back and his face upward, like a person sleeping.
3#main: One does not bury two dead side by side unless the grave wall separates between them; and not dead beside bones nor bones beside dead; but a man is buried with his minor daughter, and a woman with her minor son and with her minor grandson — this is the rule: whoever would sleep with him in life is buried with him in death.
4#main: One does not place two coffins one upon the other; and if one placed, they compel the upper one to remove; and if there is earth between them six tefachim — permitted.
5#main: One does not bury a wicked person beside a righteous person, even a severe wicked person beside a light wicked person; and likewise one does not bury a righteous, fit, or intermediate person beside an exceptionally pious person: {Rama: (But they bury a penitent beside a complete righteous person) (Beit Yosef).}
6#main: Two who hated each other — one may not bury them together.
